channel.title: Homer Tools Walkthroughs
channel.description: Short simulated walks through FileDir and the Player, for people who work by ear. Each one is a few minutes, with something to try at the end.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 0 - Overview
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-0-overview

item.title: 1 - User Interface
item.description: FileDir is open on a folder of your own, such as Documents. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-1-user-interface

item.title: 2 - Install and Launch
item.description: The installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-2-install-and-launch

item.title: 3 - Open a Folder and Find a File
item.description: FileDir is open on a folder of saved web pages. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-3-open-a-folder-and-find-a-file

item.title: 4 - Tag Files and Copy Them
item.description: A folder of files is open. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-4-tag-files-and-copy-them

item.title: 5 - Play a Page's Media in the Homer Player
item.description: FileDir is open on a folder of saved podcast directories, on Access On dot h t m. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-5-play-a-pages-media-in-the-homer-player

item.title: 6 - Rename Files to What Is Inside
item.description: A folder holds downloaded files with names that say nothing. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-6-rename-files-to-what-is-inside

item.title: 7 - Convert Between Formats
item.description: A folder holds a Word document and a PDF. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-7-convert-between-formats

item.title: 8 - Ask About a File
item.description: A model is installed for FileDir's AI commands, and a folder holds a long document. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-8-ask-about-a-file

item.title: 9 - Conclusion
item.description: Nothing is needed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-9-conclusion
